Updating MacLISP on SPEECH machine

  • To: JIS at MIT-SPEECH
  • Subject: Updating MacLISP on SPEECH machine
  • From: Jon L White <JONL at MIT-MC>
  • Date: Sat, 17 Oct 81 12:22:00 GMT
  • Cc: nlg.ja at MIT-SPEECH, GSB at MIT-ML, KWC at MIT-ML, ZUE at MIT-ML, BUG-MACLISP at MIT-ML
  • Original-date: 17 October 1981 08:22-EDT
Perhaps it would be wise to make the full MacLISP update to
SPEECH, with the current <MACLISP>LISP.EXE kept around for
a while in case anyone notices difficulties.  There used to
be a bootstrap <SUBSYS>OMACLISP.EXE  which would get the lower
version number of <MACLISP>LISP.EXE.  In general, all the
.FASL files have been tested out to work in the older lisps,
although it's possible that some differences could be detected
if one tried hard enough.
